_comment: GOOGLE_SHEET_URL: Public Google Sheet containing Amazon search URLs (one per row in first column). GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_PATH: Path to Google Service Account JSON credentials file (optional, leave empty to skip Google Sheets writing). SAVE_TO_EXCEL: Set to true to also save results to Excel files, false to only save to Google Sheets. MAX_THREADS: Number of concurrent browser instances to run. CONCURRENT_PAGES: Number of pages to process in parallel for each link. USE_PROXIES: Set to true to use proxies from proxies.txt file. HEADLESS: Set to true to run browsers in headless mode (no visible browser window, faster but harder to debug), set to false to see browser windows (useful for debugging).
